final: SELECT COUNT(*) AS combined_telescope_count, AVG(telescope_count * 1.0 / total_telescope_count) AS average_share, AVG(telescope_count * 1.0 / total_telescope_count - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS total_telescope_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS average_share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) WHERE telescope_count * 1.0 / total_telescope_count > average_share
